title: An Unexpected Reunion
next_chapter_hook: Who is this mysterious benefactor Chen Nian speaks of? Why does he wish to meet Chen Ji at this critical moment? And when will the Crown Prince's investigation fall upon Chen Ji's head?

text.content: The night was as black as ink, and the cold wind carried the distant sound of mountain pines, wailing through the broken walls of the abandoned temple. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a pile of withered grass, his Spiritual Light completely suppressed, resembling a cold corpse—this was his carefully designed feigned death state, using the power of heaven and earth to conceal his aura, lying in wait. In the distance came faint barks and the metallic clash of armor, the Crown Prince's pursuers were searching this area inch by inch.

dialogue.content: Brother, I found you.

text.content: The voice was soft as the spring breeze sweeping across a lake, yet carried a familiarity that pierced directly into the soul. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils constricting—a woman in a plain white gown stood quietly three steps away, moonlight outlining her beautiful and extraordinary silhouette. In her brow and eyes, traces of her childhood appearance remained, but added were years of composure and sharpness. Chen Nian. His missing sister, appearing before him so abruptly, as if descending from the heavens.

dialogue.content: (Forcing down surging emotions, voice slightly trembling) Xiao Nian... Is it really you? How could you...

Chen Nian did not answer immediately. Instead, she stepped forward quickly and grabbed Chen Ji's wrist. Her fingertips were ice-cold, yet carried a surging spiritual energy fluctuation that shocked the heart—an aura only possessed by Nascent Soul realm experts. Chen Ji's heart trembled violently. He had thought his sister was merely an ordinary girl taken away by the Holy Sect, never imagining that in just a few short years, she had stepped into a realm countless cultivators could not reach in their entire lives.

text.content: "All these years... You've suffered." Chen Nian's voice suddenly choked, eyes reddening yet stubbornly refusing to let tears fall. "I was searching for you the whole time—from the Holy Sect's dungeons to the Northern Wasteland's Forbidden Grounds, from solitary islands in the Eastern Sea to the miasma forests of the Southern Frontier... Brother, do you know how long I've been searching for you?" Her shoulders trembled slightly. In that instant, she was no longer that lofty Nascent Soul realm expert, just a girl separated from her brother for years. Chen Ji's throat churned, thousands of words blocking his chest, unsure where to begin. He reached out and gently covered his sister's hair, just as he had done countless times when they were young.

choice.prompt: Facing the sudden appearance of his sister after years of separation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: After so many years apart, what matters most now is not asking questions, but letting her feel the warmth of home
choices.risk_hint: The pursuing soldiers outside may be closing in

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently drew his sister into his embrace, voice low and gentle: "Silly girl, don't cry. Brother is here, and will never abandon you again." Chen Nian's body stiffened for a moment, then completely relaxed, burying her face in her brother's chest, sobbing silently. Moonlight fell upon the two siblings, outlining a warm yet heart-wrenching scene.

text.content: After a long while, Chen Nian lifted her head from her brother's embrace, randomly wiping her eyes with her sleeve, a rare smile appearing on her face: "Brother, you haven't changed... You're still trying to protect me even when you're in deep trouble yourself."

choices.description: How could sister break through to Nascent Soul realm in such a short time? There must be hidden reasons behind this
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon sister's painful memories

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently patted his sister's back, then his expression turned serious: "Xiao Nian, what exactly happened to you all these years? Nascent Soul realm... This is not a realm one can reach overnight." He paused, lowering his voice, "Was it someone from the Holy Sect helping you behind the scenes?"
Hearing this, Chen Nian's expression became complicated, as if weighing how to speak: "Brother, this is a long story... I did encounter some... noble benefactors."

choices.description: That sister could find me silently proves her extraordinary strength, but it also means others might have tracked her here
choices.visible_cost: Appear insufficiently intimate with his sister
choices.risk_hint: Miss the opportunity to understand his sister

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned sharp, but he didn't immediately rush forward to embrace his sister. His spiritual sense subtly expanded, scanning the surroundings and confirming there were no ambushes before slightly relaxing: 'Xiao Nian, you being able to find this place means your concealing technique is more advanced than I imagined. That prince outside is hunting me everywhere... How did you find me?'

Chen Nian seemed to have anticipated her brother's reaction, a bitter smile forming at the corner of her mouth: 'Brother, you're still the same... always putting danger first. Relax, I've already scouted this area, there are no pursuers.'

Chen Nian took a deep breath, her gaze becoming profound: 'Brother, do you know why the Holy Sect took me away?' She paused, her voice dropping low, 'It wasn't because I'm your sister... but because while I carry Chen bloodline, I also possess a special physique - Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, this name appeared in some ancient texts - it was said those with this physique could disrupt the path of Heavenly Dao's operation, making fate's trajectory unclear. And his Tianji Record, when predicting scenes involving his sister, always seemed like looking through a layer of mist, blurry and hard to distinguish. He always thought it was due to the incomplete Tianji Record, but now thinking, perhaps the problem lies with his sister.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian continued: 'The Holy Sect wanted to use my physique for something... but on the third year after I was taken, someone saved me. That person...' Her voice suddenly became extremely gentle, a light never seen before flickering in her eyes, 'He told me many things about the Chen family, about the Tianji Record, even about... Heavenly Dao itself. He helped me escape the Holy Sect's control, and he guided my cultivation, allowing me to break through to Transformed God realm in just a few years.'

'Who is that person?' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold and sharp, a cold light flashing in his eyes. A being capable of guiding his sister to break through Transformed God realm in just a few years was certainly no ordinary person. And this person seemed to know the Tianji Record and Chen family inside out... Is this person friend or foe?

choice.prompt: Facing the existence of this mysterious figure, Chen Ji needed to make a judgment

choices.description: Since that person helped Xiao Nian, logically and emotionally he should thank them in person, while also personally probing this person's depth

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's eyes flickered with surprise upon hearing this: 'Brother, you're willing to meet him? Wonderful! Actually...' A mischievous smile appeared, 'Besides reuniting with you this time, my biggest purpose is to take you to meet him. He said there are important matters he must tell you in person.'

Chen Ji felt a chill in his heart - as expected. Although his sister had improved rapidly in strength, she was simple-minded, likely being used without even realizing it. However, since the other party had taken the initiative to appear, it also saved him the trouble of searching for leads everywhere. 'Alright, when do we set out?' he asked decisively.

choices.description: Rash action is a taboo in military strategy, first clarify the other party's identity and purpose before making a decision
choices.risk_hint: The younger sister might become anxious

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately agree, but asked in a deep voice: 'Xiao Nian, besides his name, what else did that person tell you? His identity, origins... even if it's just a guess.' Chen Nian pondered for a moment, slowly saying: 'He never revealed his true identity, only asking us to call him 'Night Watcher'. But he said something that left a deep impression on me - he said the Tianji Record is not the only chessboard, and Heavenly Dao... is also not the highest chess player.'

text.content: Heavenly Dao is not the highest chess player. Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted, this sentence was like a thunderbolt hacking into his mind. Heavenly Dao's Eye - that terrifying existence he only became aware of until Volume 8, could this Night Watcher have already known? He took a deep breath, suppressing the turbulent waves in his heart: 'What else did he say?'

choices.text: Warn his sister to be careful of this person
choices.description: A favor of unclear origin often hides ulterior motives, reminding the sister to stay vigilant.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji frowned, his tone turning stern: "Little Nian, I'm not questioning your judgment, but a stranger who saved you for no reason, guided you, and knows everything about you... There are no coincidences in this world. Have you thought about what his real purpose is in approaching you?"

Chen Nian was stunned, then sighed softly: "Brother, I understand everything you said. But there's one thing I'm certain of—he harbors no malicious intent toward you. In fact, he asked me to relay a message: 'Be cautious of those who claim to be Heaven's Way, for they are not as impartial and just as you believe.' Brother, what does this mean?"

text.content: A cold sweat instantly broke out on Chen Ji's back. The Eye of Heaven's Way—that terrifying existence about which he still knew nothing—had some people already discovered it? He forced himself to remain composed and took a deep breath: "Little Nian, what else did the Night Watchman say? Did he provide any concrete details about the entity 'transcending Heaven's Way'?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian shook her head, her expression growing grave: "He only said that when you sense an inexplicable chill while using the Tianji Record, or glimpse a massive eye watching you in your visions, that's its way of warning you—you've been marked by 'that existence.'" She paused, then added, "He also mentioned that while the Tianji Record is powerful, each page comes with a price. The more you use it, the closer you draw to... that unspeakable entity."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Mo Xiansheng had vaguely hinted at a grander game behind the Tianji Record, and he had always assumed the Eye of Heaven's Way was the mastermind behind it. Now it seemed this game was far more intricate than imagined—someone was setting the board, someone was attempting to break it, and he himself might have been merely a piece from the very beginning. Yet even so, he would be the piece capable of seeing the entire board, not a discarded pawn to be manipulated.

choice.prompt: Faced with these startling revelations, Chen Ji needed to make a decision.

choices.text: Go meet the Night Watchman immediately.
choices.description: Since the other party holds such crucial information, an in-person meeting is urgent.
choices.risk_hint: It might be the enemy's trap.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji rose to his feet, his gaze resolute: "Little Nian, take me to him. Since he could say such things, I must see for myself what kind of entity this is." A glint of relief flickered in Chen Nian's eyes as she nodded vigorously: "Alright, brother, follow me." Her form blurred, already executing the divine technique of compressing earth, light swirling beneath her feet, clearly intending to transport her brother to the destination at maximum speed.

text.content: Just as the two were about to depart, Chen Ji suddenly halted, glancing back at the distant flickering lights—the prince's pursuers were still searching. Forget it, let that upstart enjoy his smugness for a few more days. Once he obtained answers from the Night Watchman, he would properly deal with these reckless fools. A cold smile curved his lips before he vanished into the night alongside his sister.

choices.text: First clarify the location before deciding.
choices.description: Once the destination is known, one can plan the route and countermeasures in advance.
choices.risk_hint: A long night brings many dreams—delays invite trouble.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately follow his sister, instead asking in a low voice: "Where exactly is this place we're going? Is it far? Will we pass through any faction's territory along the way?" Chen Nian was momentarily surprised, then smiled with understanding: "Brother, you truly remain cautious as always. Rest assured, the destination lies within a secret realm in the Northern Wasteland—a place outsiders find extremely difficult to enter. If we take the transportation array, we'll arrive in just half an hour."

text.content: Northern Wasteland secret realm. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, for it was notoriously treacherous—fewer than one in ten ordinary cultivators who entered would survive. Yet if a truly formidable expert were indeed hiding there, it would make sense. After contemplating for a moment, he finally nodded: "Very well, you lead the way. But remember—once we arrive, everything proceeds according to my arrangements."

choices.text: Let his sister go ahead while he guards the rear.
choices.description: To prevent anyone from tracking them, he let his sister leave first while he stayed behind to erase all traces.
choices.visible_cost: Having to briefly separate from his sister.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "Little Nian, go ahead and wait for me outside the city. I need to set up some things to prevent the pursuers from tracking us by our aura." Chen Nian opened her mouth to protest, but chose silence when she met her brother's eyes, deep as an abyss. She sighed, "Brother, you're always like this... Fine, I'll wait for you on the hillside fifty li outside the city. You have the time of one incense stick. If you haven't arrived by then, I'll come back to find you."

text.content: Chen Nian's figure vanished into the night sky like a shooting star, while Chen Ji turned and walked deeper into the ruined temple. His fingers gently brushed the moss on the walls, and a cold, cruel smile appeared at the corner of his mouth—if the young prince liked to hunt bugs so much, he might as well let him search thoroughly. He took out several faintly glowing formation flags from his sleeve and quickly arranged them. In no time, the entire ruined temple was shrouded in an eerie mist, and any intruder would lose their way.

dialogue.content: Half an hour later, in a secluded valley somewhere in the Northern Wasteland. Chen Nian led Chen Ji through layers of prohibitions, finally arriving before a deep stone cave. A faint mist lingered at the cave entrance, and within, faint Spiritual Light flickered. "Brother, we're here." Chen Nian's voice carried a hint of nervousness, "He... should be waiting for you inside." Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped into the stone cave. The interior was far more spacious than it appeared from outside, with countless glowing pearls embedded in the stone walls, illuminating the entire space as bright as day. And at the deepest part of the cave, a blurry figure sat cross-legged, as if it had been waiting for them for a long time.

text.content: That figure slowly raised its head, revealing a face that was aged yet with eyes sharp as torches. His voice was ancient and calm, as if drifting from the primordial chaos of远古洪荒: "You've finally come, descendant of the Chen family. I've been waiting for you... for a very long time." Chen Ji's pupils slightly constricted—how could this person know his identity so precisely? This was by no means something an ordinary person could do. He suppressed the stormy waves in his heart, his face still unruffled, and clasped his hands in salute: "Senior, you've gone to great lengths to arrange this meeting. May I know what guidance you wish to offer?" The old man chuckled: "Guidance is too grand a word. I merely wish to tell you a truth—the truth about the Tianji Record, the truth about the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and... the enemy you are fated to face."

The air within the stone cave seemed to solidify. Chen Ji felt every hair on his body stand on end. How many secrets did this old man who called himself the Watchkeeper hold? And was the "enemy destined by fate" he mentioned that terrifying existence beyond the heavenly Dao? Just as he was about to ask, the old man raised his hand to interrupt: "No rush. We can discuss these matters later. You've traveled a long way and must be exhausted. Let your sister take you down to rest first. When tomorrow comes—" his voice suddenly became deeply meaningful, "I will tell you everything." Chen Nian beside him gently tugged at her brother's sleeve, her eyes full of anticipation. Chen Ji was silent for a long moment before finally nodding. Regardless of whether this Watchkeeper was friend or foe, one thing was certain—the chessboard in his hands was about to face new variables.
